reason: I have one apartment and Booking and Airbnb already send my scheduled messages, plus the rules sheet is on the fridge. €150 setup and €35 a month is real money when the whole year brings me about €7,000, just to answer things I've already written down.
objection: If it tells a German guest the wrong parking spot or the wrong check-out time, I'm the one who gets the bad review, not the AI. And I'd still be answering the hard questions on WhatsApp myself.
would_change_my_mind: No setup fee and around €10 to €15 a month only for July and August, plus seeing it answer my own guests' German questions correctly during the free trial.
